items.title: Sam LaPorta: Season-best numbers in loss
items.body_text: LaPorta brought in eight of 13 targets for 84 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 32-26 loss to the Panthers on Sunday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
